{{Top|leg}}
[[File:TipocaCity-CC.png|thumb|right|250px|Tipoca City on Kamino utilized Krorral-style domed structures.]]
'''Krorral''' was a form of architecture known for its use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] of [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], and adaptation on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Krorral utilized domed structures that were effective in shedding rain and wind.

==Description==
Krorral was an architectural form that involved large dome structures and&mdash;like other architecture developed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]&mdash;emphasized the integration of a building with its environment. The domes were highly effective in keeping [[Water/Legends|rainwater]] flowing off their surfaces.<ref name="Geonosis" />

==History==
Krorral was known for its Middle-period use in the compounds of the [[Gkrur clan/Legends|Gkrur clan]] on the Kashyyyk and in the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] of [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]],<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] also in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The architecture resembled the original terrestrial [[Colonist/Legends|colonies]] on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], which were constructed with wattle and daub and suited the long stormy seasons. After Kamino's ice age ended, causing a [[Great Flood]] and constant rain<ref name="Geonosis" /> beginning in [[19,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the graceful curves<ref name="Databank">{{DB|location|tipocacity|Tipoca City}}</ref> of Middle-period Krorral were adopted in almost every major [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[City/Legends|city]], including the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]],<ref name="Geonosis" /> and [[Timira City]]<ref name="FUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> for their rain-sloughing<ref name="Geonosis" /> and wind-shedding<ref name="Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> nature and resemblance to the old colonies. The design of these cities, along with stilts applied from the [[Alderaanian Oversea]] style, were some of the only instances of offworld influence on Kaminoan culture,<ref name="Geonosis" /> provided by some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] keenest architectural minds.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The domed architecture of Tipoca City was first described in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], written by [[R. A. Salvatore]]. It was later identified as Krorral in the [[2004]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]], ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', written by [[Craig Robert Carey|Craig R. Carey]], [[Jason Fry]], [[Jeff Quick]], and [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="Geonosis" /> and was again directly referred to in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|249|Tipoca City}}</ref>
